notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
Balance Updates

Map bosses now appear less often
Lowered item drop rate from normal monsters
Tier 4 maps are now called "Hell Mode"

General Gameplay Updates

Max level is now 100.

Trader now sells normal items by default. You can increase the available tiers by purchasing the respective upgrades.
Made UX improvements to Trader, Upgrades windows.

New Upgrades

Added an in-game damage tracker which you can unlock through the Upgrades menu along with 8 new upgrades.

New feature: Cardsets

Each cardset offers a reward once you have collected all its cards.
Once a cardset is completed, you can level it using "Exp Elixir"
Cardsets can be leveled up to lvl 3 and offers a stat bonus at each level.

New class: Rogue

Rogue can now be unlocked at Lv. 30
She can wield 1h swords and daggers. Her specialty is critical hits and damage over time effects.

Guardian Battles

You can now challenge map guardians for a chance at rare loot.

Forest Guardian (Lv.50+)
Desert Priestess (Lv.60+)
Goblin King (Lv.70+)
Mermaid Queen (Lv.80+)
Holy Knight (Lv.90+)

Guardian summon scrolls has a small chance to drop from Map Bosses in Hell Mode dungeons.

New crafting option: Enchantments

You can now add enchantments to your armor and weapons using Shards. Shards can be acquired by defeating Guardians.

New feature: Quests

Early game experience improved with some quests. Some late game quests can be added later on.

New uniques

Along with the new unique items from Kingdom map, we also added several new unique relics. They can be acquired from Guardian maps.

notes.title: What we are working on
notes.content:
Hello, i wanted to tell a bit about our future plans and what i am currently working on.

As you might know, the game had several bugs (with two game breaking bugs) when it first came out, i spent the first two weeks fixing all the major bugs and also added the option to make the game full screen (it is under the Settings)

So my focus is on adding new features and adding some QoL elements. Each of these additions will try to solve an existing problem.

Problem 1: Early game not engaging enough

One feedback that came from multiple users was that early game feels boring and a bit confusing. To solve this problem I've decided to add a "Quest" system. I believe this will increase the interaction in the early game and also serve as a mini "tutorial".

Problem 2: Not enough content

Several people who made it to Lv.40+ complained about this. So we have decided to add some new content which was planned a while ago;

- Boss Fights. The player will be able to challenge the Map Guardians. This will require a key and during the fights some active input will be required to get the highest score.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050596/d80f3d7c3352c54a74b6598a3ab10e0c4886cc21.gif

- Cardsets: Most cards now will be part of a cardset. Completing a cardset will give you a rare reward.

- New Class: Rogue is coming, along with new item modifiers (mainly DoT and poison related)

- New crafting options.

Problem 3: Not enough upgrade / achievements

Several people complained about this and I was already planning to increase them. So new upgrades and around 20 new achievements will be added. Certain achievements will also provide an in game reward.

These is of course more to talk about. But for now I wanted to share this with anyone following the game.

Our next update will be in September, can not give an exact date, but I don't want to rush things. I will release an announcement a few days before the patch.

notes.title: Patch Notes - August 12
notes.content:
New map

Added a new map: Atlantis (Lv.41-60)

Added three new unique items
Added a new item modifier for weapons (Basic attack damage +(value)%)
Added a new item modifier for wands and armor (Healing Efficiency +(value)%)

General

Max level is now 60
You can now drag and drop items in your inventory

Increased weapon modifier pool. Weapons can now have attribute modifiers in addition to the newly introduced modifiers.

Agility now additionally provides 0.01 attack speed per point.
Intelligence no longer provides critical hit rate. It now provides 0.1 healing efficiency per point instead.
Strength now provides 2.8 attack bonus instead of 4.

These values will be adjusted if necessary.

Attack Speed

When your attack speed is 3 or higher, you now gain 0.1 cooldown reduction
When your attack speed is 4 or higher, you now gain 0.2 cooldown reduction
These values do not stack

New Modifiers

Added a new attribute type: Vitality
Added a new attribute type: Luck

Vitality provides 0.1 HP regen per second and 0.2 max HP per point.
Luck provides 0.2 critical hit rate per point.

Vitality is available for item level 11 or above gear
Luck is available for item level 21 or above gear

Added a new hit type: Lucky Hit

When your critical hit rate is over 100, the overcapped points are calculated for a chance to "Lucky Hit". Lucky Hit damage is equal to 1.4 times your critical damage. 

For example; if you have 120% critical hit rate and deal 2000 critical damage to an enemy, there is a 20% chance to deal an additional 0.4 * 2000 = 800 damage as Lucky Hit.

Balance Changes

Decreased stat value for flat HP modifier at Lv.21 and above item levels
Increased the unlock level for drop charms to Lv. 31, their prices have been adjusted
Increaseed unlock level for Exp Charm III to Lv. 15
